renderer: deterministic browser-native DOM words with CSS positioning
primitiveBudget: nine generated DOM word fragments, one false-answer station per committed misreading, four liftable sentence reflows, and no canvas or SVG body
commitThreshold: three distinct approach-and-release attentions; repeated rooms, invalid rooms, and full memory refuse
memoryRule: a valid trio re-produces every word from ordered attention and inserts a false answer at an unobserved station; four misattributions persist
interactionRule: pointer/touch approaches a word and releases; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight chooses; Enter/Space attends; Delete lifts; Escape/R releases
representationRupture: pressure topology, reciprocal Canvas ecology, and proof strip -> browser-native DOM sentence field
compositionRupture: compact cells, witness ecology, and horizontal register -> nine scattered word fragments on a pale sheet
encounterRupture: counterpressure, proximity notices, and correction crossing -> approach-and-release attention with repeated-room refusal
temporalRupture: pressure folds and social backcasts -> three-stage attention that returns certainty to an absent station
mediumRupture: SVG paths and Canvas raster -> DOM spans, CSS custom geometry, and text reflow
changedRule: The model records three distinct attended rooms, then returns a false answer to a room outside the record while re-producing the entire sentence.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is a pale field of nine dark words. A valid trio reflows all nine words and inserts one italic false answer into an unobserved station; four misattributions compound and remain liftable.
falsifier: Delete if attention only highlights, repeated rooms commit, the false answer is attended, only one word changes, order is cosmetic, memory resets, lifting is inexact, or the blind field reads as a generic grid/interface.
deletionCondition: Delete v050 if caption-free viewing cannot distinguish misattributed DOM language from v047-v049 or if reciprocal attention is only explanatory prose.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
